audit.why: Akshan owns levels 1 through first item against a Sion who is farming; Sion takes over at 2+ items. 53.62% over 69 games and the 6/7 Akshan chart agree.
Spikes land on Lvl 1-2 poke, Lvl 3 Heroic Swing, Youmuu's, and Sion's tank-item takeover. All four match the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims Sion's E breaks shields ('break yours with E', 'shield-breaking E'). Roar of the Slayer does no such thing — it damages, slows and reduces Armor, and knocks a minion back through everything behind it. Glory in Death (P) is also treated as a body rather than a healing, max-health-damage second life.
audit.why: Riot description of Roar of the Slayer: short-range shockwave that damages, slows and reduces Armor of the first enemy hit; if it hits a minion the minion is knocked back and hits everything it passes through. Glory in Death: attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on the target's maximum Health. Two different shield claims in two layers were both false, and the actual armor shred and the anti-heal requirement were absent.
audit.corrected: Roar of the Slayer (E, 12/11/10/9/8s) shreds armour and shoves a minion through you — that is his ranged poke, not a shield-break. Glory in Death heals him off your max health, so Grievous Wounds decides whether the second life ends.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. 'Long Q recovery', 'his W shield' — no numbers.
audit.why: Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s and Soul Furnace is 15/14/13/12/11s. Those turn 'punish the recovery' into a stated window.
audit.corrected: Q down 10s at rank 1; W down 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite Glory in Death.
audit.why: The reanimation heals off every rapid attack; without Grievous Wounds the zombie outlives the fight it died in.

edits.after: Sidestep charged Decimating Smash or jump out of Heroic Swing early, then punish the 10s Q recovery with Avengerang chip

edits.before: Soak the poke with his W shield, break yours with E, and farm safely to stack tank items
edits.after: Soak poke with Soul Furnace (W) and shove minions through you with Roar of the Slayer (E)

edits.before: His charged Decimating Smash is slow to wind up — sidestep it and punish the long recovery, since it's his only tool to lock you into melee.
edits.after: Decimating Smash (Q) winds up slowly on a 10s cooldown — sidestep it and you own the next ten seconds, since it is his only lock into melee.

edits.before: His W shield and shield-breaking E don't sustain, so your second-shot poke out-damages anything he can do back across an exchange.
edits.after: Soul Furnace (W) shields on a 15s cooldown and heals nothing — chip it off, wait the reactivate, and your poke beats anything he returns.

edits.before: This is your window. With Heroic Swing at 3 you swing around lane terrain to fire on him from outside his Q range and reset the swing on any takedown, while your passive second shot keeps out-poking the chip he can't heal — his W shield and E only break shields, they don't sustain. At 6 Comeuppance executes off the low bar you've built with Avengerang, scaling harder the more missing health you set up. Bait the Decimating Smash, jump out of your swing or sidestep it, then punish the long recovery. Once Youmuu's is online every reset snowballs and you can W-camo near terrain to roam.
edits.after: This is your window. With Heroic Swing at 3 you swing around lane terrain to fire on him from outside his Q range and reset the swing on any takedown, while your passive second shot out-pokes chip he cannot heal — Soul Furnace (W) only shields, and only every 15s. At 6 Comeuppance executes off the low bar you've built with Avengerang, scaling harder the more missing health you set up. Bait Decimating Smash, jump out of your swing or sidestep it, then take the 10s window it leaves. Once Youmuu's is online every reset snowballs and you can W-camo near terrain to roam.

edits.before: The clock is the threat. A farmed Sion becomes a problem once he's a few tank items deep — his armor swallows your lethality and a fully-charged Decimating Smash knocks you up to start a fight on his team's terms, where his zombie passive keeps him swinging after death. Close this lane in the early-mid window: snowball off the Heroic Swing reset and Comeuppance picks, take plates and roam before he scales. In fights, never get caught flat in front of his charge — hang back, fire Comeuppance from range, and let your frontline absorb the body he turns into.
edits.after: The clock is the threat. A farmed Sion becomes a problem once he's a few tank items deep — his armor swallows your lethality and a fully-charged Decimating Smash knocks you up to start a fight on his team's terms. Killing him is not a kill: Glory in Death (P) reanimates him with rapid attacks that heal off your max health, so Grievous Wounds decides whether that second life ends. Close the lane in the early-mid window: snowball off the Heroic Swing reset and Comeuppance picks, take plates and roam. In fights hang back and fire Comeuppance from range.

edits.before: Sion out-scales hard — a few tank items shrug off your lethality and his charged Q knockup starts fights for his team, so close it before then.
edits.after: Sion out-scales hard — Roar of the Slayer (E) shreds your armour, Soul Furnace hits for max health, and a charged Q knockup starts fights for him.

notes: Both layers asserted Sion's E breaks shields; it does not — it shreds armour and knocks a minion through you. That is his real ranged poke and it was never mentioned. Added Q 10s / W 15s numbers to answer the packet's no-sequencing defect, and the Grievous Wounds requirement for Glory in Death.
